name: Assassin’s Draw
body:
You have practiced a deadly drawing strike for hidden weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 17, Sleight of Hand 3 ranks, Quick Draw

Benefit(s): Once per round, if you draw a light weapon and attack in the same round, the target is considered flat-footed against the first attack made after drawing the weapon. Once a creature has been affected by this feat, they are immune to its effects for 1 minute.
